Swoop model v1: does a stall-limited pitch model reproduce the swoops?

MODEL study, not a flight result. Method and pre-stated checks are frozen in README.md (hash checked). Dark on-screen page.

Did the model agree with the flights?
  • Swift A foam 400 (as flown 73 mm behind the nose tip, tail bend 6 deg): (a) glides in 11/11 variants, (b) persistent and stalling in 0/11, (c) 3 mm forward halves the amplitude in 0/11. Variants that agree with the flights ((a) and (b)): 0/11.
  • B45 flat wing, centre flaps (as flown 66 mm aft of the root LE, flap up 10 deg): (a) glides in 11/11 variants, (b) persistent and stalling in 0/11, (c) 3 mm forward halves the amplitude in 7/11. Variants that agree with the flights ((a) and (b)): 0/11.

Post-hoc additions (after the reviewer's REVISE; not part of the frozen plan)

CP-shift size is an input from the Re-60k table (about 3x the B45 static margin; sign unknown for a swept tailless wing). The gust explanation stays a hypothesis unless the excursions are crest-locked.

Test proposals from the frozen rule (model suggests, flight decides; Kai decides)

The model did not reproduce the swoops or the Swift's nose dive, so these are not validated predictions. Swift: the model cannot see the Swift's swoops (it says smooth), which does not mean the Swift is fine. B45 'trim faster to widen the margin to the break' (64/8, 63/10) costs more pull-out loss, more static margin and higher speed; step in small increments, CG 65 first.
